US Core Inflation Eases, Easing Pressure on Federal Reserve

US core inflation data showed a subdued increase, easing pressure on the Federal Reserve regarding interest rate hikes. This development contributed to a rally in Asian equities, with the MSCI Asia Pacific Index reflecting positive sentiment. In Japan, wholesale inflation remained elevated at 7.2% in July, though it undershot expectations and eased slightly, potentially bolstering bets on a September rate hike. Meanwhile, South Korean stocks rose significantly, nearing a technical bull market driven by a global rebound in AI trade.
